question: The Kolkata Port is located on which river?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Hoogly__**

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Kolkata harbour is situated on the Hugli river, near the Bay of Bengal. Iit is not a natural port. **It is developed artificially**.

 
• **Hugli-Chuchura or Hooghly-Chinsurah is a city and a municipality of Hooghly **district in the Indian state of West Bengal.
 
• It lies on the bank of Hooghly River, 35 km north of Kolkata.
 
• It is located in the district of Hooghly and is home to the district headquarters.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
